Players Committee card image of [[Stolen Data Tapes (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Deploy on R2-D2. If about to leave table (even from Overwhelmed), relocate to Dune Sea (if possible). If at Dune Sea, may relocate to your character there. If at Alderaan (or a 'blown away' system), tapes 'delivered;' relocate this Effect to table and may take any card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/stolendatatapes_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 793bf65] (15 January 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
